description: Unsampled ingress-access observations from Caddy and nginx. Records describe a request at a proxy layer; they do not identify a person, account, or registration state. The default view is nginx-origin observations to avoid counting the same proxied request twice. Cloudflare-only requests are absent unless Cloudflare edge Logpush is configured separately.

panels.description:
Factual proxy-observation count by status.

```logql
sum by (status) (count_over_time({compose_project="ascendance-social", service_name=~"frontend|caddy"} | json | __error__="" | event="ingress.access" | source_layer=~"$sourceLayer" | client_ip=~"$clientIp" | request_path=~"$path" [$__interval]))
```

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({compose_project="ascendance-social", service_name=~"frontend|caddy"} | json | __error__="" | event="ingress.access" | source_layer=~"$sourceLayer" | client_ip=~"$clientIp" | request_path=~"$path" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Proxy observations by status

panels.description:
Factual proxy-observation count by original request path. Use this to investigate bursts; it does not label visitors or infer intent.

```logql
sum by (request_path) (count_over_time({compose_project="ascendance-social", service_name=~"frontend|caddy"} | json | __error__="" | event="ingress.access" | source_layer=~"$sourceLayer" | client_ip=~"$clientIp" | request_path=~"$path" [$__interval]))
```

targets.expr: sum by (request_path) (count_over_time({compose_project="ascendance-social", service_name=~"frontend|caddy"} | json | __error__="" | event="ingress.access" | source_layer=~"$sourceLayer" | client_ip=~"$clientIp" | request_path=~"$path" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Raw evidence records. Expand a row for plaintext observed client IP, peer IP, original path, method, status, timing, proxy outcome, selected browser headers, origin, safe referrer path, CF-Ray, and source/protocol attribution. Caddy redirect/proxy records are a separate source layer from nginx origin records.
